cookies.title: Your privacy matters
cookies.description: We use strictly necessary cookies to make the app work. With your permission, we also use analytics cookies to understand how TrenATiempo is used and to improve it.
cookies.necessaryDescription: Essential for the app to work: remember your language, session and chosen date.
cookies.analyticsDescription: Help us understand how you use the app (Google Analytics) to improve it. We never sell your data.

legal.title: Privacy policy
legal.intro: At TrenATiempo we take your privacy very seriously. This page explains what data we process, for what purpose and which cookies we use.
legal.responsibleText: The data controller for the data processed through TrenATiempo is SC Technology Solutions. For any privacy question you can contact us at info@sctechsolutions.es.
legal.dataText: No registration is required to check train schedules. If you decide to create an account, we process your email address, your name and your preferences (language and cookie consent) solely to personalise your experience and keep your session active. We never sell or share your data with third parties, except where required by law.
legal.cookiesIntro: These are the cookies TrenATiempo may store in your browser:
legal.c2Purpose: Remember the language you prefer in the app
legal.c3Purpose: Keep you signed in (registered users only)
legal.storageNote: In addition, TrenATiempo uses your browser's local storage (localStorage) to remember your visual theme and recently viewed stations. This data never leaves your device and you can delete it at any time in your browser settings.
legal.rightsText: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure and objection by writing to info@sctechsolutions.es. You can also change your cookie preferences at any time from the “Cookie consent” section of your profile.
